---
title: "Report on Adrian's time working on the AIS project"
output: word_document
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, comment='', dpi=400)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)

# get the Excel data; tidy up some entries
data = read_excel('../time_spent_AIS.xlsx', sheet=1, skip=1) %>%
  mutate(Notes = str_replace(Notes, 'entry valid', 'entry, valid'),
      Notes = ifelse(str_detect(tolower(Notes), 'protocol'), 'Protocol', Notes),
      Notes = ifelse(str_detect(tolower(Notes), 'coding'), 'Programming', Notes),
      Notes = ifelse(str_detect(Notes, '^Meeting'), 'Meetings', Notes))
```

# Cumulative plot over time

```{r plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
total_hours = sum(data$Hours)
colour = 'darkseagreen3'
tplot = ggplot(data = data, aes(x = Date))+
  stat_ecdf(aes(y = after_stat(y) * total_hours), geom = "step", size=1.05, col=colour) +
  ylab('Cumulative hours')+
  xlab('Date')+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(text = element_text(size=20))
tplot
```

# Summary of tasks

```{r table}
tasks = group_by(data, Notes) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            Total = sum(Hours)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  mutate(Total = round(Total)) %>%
  rename('Total hours' = 'Total')
ftab = flextable(tasks) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_box()
ftab
```

The total amount of time spent was `r round(total_hours)` hours which is `r round(total_hours/7.25)` working days.
